selectionGlyphs.note: These live OUTSIDE the Icon Library / Masters frame (426:55) and are easy to miss when extracting only that frame.

footprint.note: Inline SVG is mandatory. An cannot inherit currentColor, and the Figma contract requires the consumer to supply semantic color.

Size.note: The Icon Frame scales the complete source instance, so the 1.8-unit stroke scales with it (48px box => 3.6px rendered stroke). Achieved by fixing viewBox at 0 0 24 24 and sizing only the box.

Color.note: Never set on the icon. The glyph is neutral and inherits `color` from the consuming component; all strokes and fills are currentColor.

a11y.meaningful: set data-ol8-icon-label; hydration promotes it to role="img" + aria-label
invariants: focusable="false" on the svg keeps it out of the IE/Edge tab order.
An icon inside a labelled control stays decorative — the control owns the accessible name.
Never rely on color alone: status glyphs (critical/caution/positive/informative) have distinct silhouettes by design.

forbid.reason: Breaks currentColor inheritance; the consumer can no longer supply semantic color.
Figma scales the source geometrically. A constant stroke contradicts the documented 1.8-unit optical stroke.
Masters are neutral. Use currentColor and set `color` on the consumer.
The leaf is fixed-size; both dimensions must be explicit.
Only the eleven Icon Frame universal sizes exist.

examples.note: mirrors under [dir=rtl] via the semantic registry
declarative placeholder; hydrateIcons() upgrades it to role="img" + aria-label

notes: Masters bake one ink each and it is always discarded for currentColor. The neutral sources bake #151817; the selection glyphs bake #1a2a59 (check) and #e2e9ff (selected-dot). The build fails if a master carries more than one distinct ink.

The 18px Small master is an exact 0.75x geometric scale of the 24px Standard master — verified path-by-path on Add: M12 5V19M5 12H19 @1.8 -> M9 3.75V14.25M3.75 9H14.25 @1.35. Figma's own description on node 379:2 claims an 'independently drawn 18px optical master; 1.5px rounded stroke', which the built asset contradicts. Geometric scaling is correct.

figma.description: Oneli8 canonical Button molecule. Figma maps Size -> size, State -> deterministic visual evidence, Label -> children, Show Leading/Trailing Icon -> icon presence. Runtime-only native button semantics, disabled, loading, pressed, fullWidth and iconMotion remain implemented and tested in code; they must not become fake visual axes.

elementRules.note: class ol8-btn, no type attribute; cannot be natively disabled

content.note: suppressed while loading; the spinner takes this slot

Variant.note: Secondary and Quiet share byte-identical color roles. The ONLY differentiator is --ol8-component-button-secondaryboundary (2px stroke tracking the content color); Quiet binds no boundary token. Verified on nodes 15:824 vs 15:825.

Size.note: Only two gap tokens exist: Compact+Standard share 6px, Comfortable+Large share 9px. Button size governs icon size; never set a size on the glyph.

State.note: Six Figma States are visual evidence for review, NOT six markup variants.

Focus.implementation: inset box-shadow of --ol8-focus-ring-innerwidth in --ol8-color-focus-outer. Figma draws the ring as an INSIDE stroke, so focused and unfocused variants measure identically; `outline` would sit outside and change the box.

Loading.note: Spinner occupies the leading slot by default; a leading icon is suppressed so the button never shows two competing leading glyphs. Figma's codegen emits both — pass keepLeadingIconWhileLoading (or data-ol8-loading-keep-icon="true") for that literal reading. Rotation is opt-in and guarded by prefers-reduced-motion: Figma 379:7 says Reduced Motion keeps the static busy mark.

invariants: <button> always carries an explicit type; never rely on the implicit submit.
Label lives in .ol8-btn__label and stays in the DOM while loading so the accessible name is stable.
A link styled as a button cannot be natively disabled: use aria-disabled + tabindex=-1 and swallow activation.
Focus ring is never removed without replacement; it is drawn inside so it cannot be clipped by an overflow parent.

forbid.reason: States are CSS pseudo-classes or attributes, never modifier classes. The Figma description forbids fake visual axes explicitly.
Never a div. Use <button>, or <a> for navigation.
Figma's focus ring is an inside stroke; outline sits outside and changes the measured box.
Inside a button the size is governed by data-ol8-size; never set it on the glyph.
No literal colors. Bind --ol8-* semantic roles.

verification.method: in-browser measurement against Figma node geometry
verification.widths: constant -0.67px vs Figma's stored integer widths — Figma rounds its hug width up (label advance 52.33 -> 53); padding, gap and icon geometry are exact
verification.focusRing: keyboard focus produces inset 0 0 0 3px rgb(16,27,58) with unchanged box

deviations.figma: codegen emits the leading icon AND the spinner
deviations.here: spinner takes the leading slot by default; opt in to both with keepLeadingIconWhileLoading / data-ol8-loading-keep-icon
deviations.reason: the source is ambiguous — the measured Loading widths come from variants with no leading icon, so they do not disambiguate. Default avoids two competing leading glyphs and keeps width predictable.

footprint.structure: TWO boxes: .ol8-icon-btn is the transparent protected TARGET; .ol8-icon-btn__surface is the painted VISIBLE box inside it.
footprint.note: Collapsing them into one element shrinks the touch target from 48px to 36px at Compact. The split is the component.

Shape.note: Rounded Square is the canonical base; Circle is a governed presentation extension (radius-full).

State.note: Same rule as ol8-btn: pseudo-classes and attributes, never modifier classes.

values.Focus: :focus-visible, OUTSIDE two-tone ring: inner --ol8-color-focus-inner at 3px declared FIRST, outer --ol8-color-focus-outer at 6px second, so both bands paint. Figma declares them the other way round, which occludes the inner band.
values.Loading: [data-ol8-loading] — paints with the HOVER colors in Figma, not the default ones

a11y.mandatory: Accessible name. renderIconButton throws without one; hydrateIconButtons reports any unnamed button.
invariants: The symbol never translates, rotates or scales — hover changes the container only.
The protected target stays >= 48px even when the visible box is 36px.

forbid.reason: The glyph must sit inside .ol8-icon-btn__surface, not directly in the target.
The symbol never moves; hover changes the container only.

verification.geometry: target 48/48/48/60, box 36/42/48/60, artwork 18/18/24/24 — all exact in-browser

iconContrast.note: All families now pass WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1). Figma binds --ol8-color-icon-primary for every family, which measured 1.94:1 on Primary and 2.17:1 on Destructive; the glyph is bound to the action content role instead. This is a deliberate deviation from the source — see README.

deviations.figma: glyph bound to --ol8-color-icon-primary for all families
deviations.here: glyph bound to --ol8-color-action<family>-content on Primary and Destructive
deviations.reason: WCAG 1.4.11 — 1.94:1 and 2.17:1 measured against a 3:1 minimum

deviations.figma: 0 0 0 6px focus-outer, 0 0 0 3px focus-inner — dark paints over light, only one band renders
deviations.here: inner declared first so both bands render
deviations.reason: the two focus colour tokens describe a two-tone ring; the source order makes one of them dead

rules: Components consume SEMANTIC roles only. Primitives (color-<family>-<step>) are hidden from pickers in Figma and must not appear in component code.
color-primary-* is an alias ramp onto color-blue-* — identical values, distinct names. Prefer the semantic role over either.
Dimension scale is 3px-atomic. Even multiples for structural layout; odd multiples are deliberate optical or micro-gap choices.
Elevation ink is cyan-840 rgb(22,63,75) — never default black.
Typography roles are composite. Use the .ol8-type-<role> class, not the individual font vars.
shape-radius-full (999px) is reserved for pills and circles. Soft hexagons are component-specific recipes, not a radius token.

verification.method: in-browser computed-style diff against Figma get_variable_defs

figma.description: Material adapter — NOT a fifth semantic variant. Geometry, meaning, accessibility, protected target, Size, State, content and native behavior are inherited from the regular molecule. Material changes only the token-bound surface and inner focus edge. Reduced Transparency resolves to the regular opaque equivalent. Quiet and Destructive use the regular material until a distinct Gem treatment is explicitly approved.

gem.note: Gem is an attribute on an existing button, never a new class or variant. renderButton/renderIconButton throw for quiet and destructive.

layers.::after: rim: specular top edge + integrated light rim

gradient.why: All three baked angles satisfy the rule to 4 decimal places, which is exactly CSS's corner keyword (gradient line perpendicular to the opposite diagonal). The keyword reproduces Figma at any size AND any label width; a baked degree value is only correct for the single instance it was measured on.
gradient.verified: mix-blend-mode:difference overlay of baked-angle vs to-bottom-right renders pure black at all three sizes

stateMap.Pressed: reuses the HOVER stops, adds drop-shadow(0 9px 12px cutedge-shadow) and rim-hover
stateMap.Disabled: gem layers suppressed; regular opaque treatment shows through

reducedTransparency.behavior: ::before and ::after are hidden, revealing the regular molecule's own background, which is never removed. Secondary also regains its 2px boundary.

verification.disabled: gem layers display:none, opaque #e7e0d1 shows through

Icon / Selection / Checkbox.note: A stateful icon component set, not a plain glyph. Belongs with a Checkbox control atom; it composes the check and mixed glyphs.

Icon / Selection / Radio.note: Composes the selected-dot glyph. Belongs with a Radio control atom.
